events.verdict: Booker (PHX) moves his pivot foot after gathering.
Nurkic (PHX) makes contact with Adebayo's (MIA) right arm, which affects his ability to secure the rebound.
Highsmith (MIA) reaches for the loose ball and incidental hand on ball contact occurs with Nurkic (PHX) as the ball is knocked away.
Durant (PHX) takes a slight step laterally as he is firming up in a screening position, but the contact with Herro's (MIA) side is marginal.
Durant (PHX) jumps from point A to point B into Rozier's (MIA) body, initiating contact that causes him to lose his balance.
Jones (PHX) makes a normal basketball move to receive the throw-in and there is marginal contact with Rozier's (MIA) head.
Highsmith (MIA) moves laterally into Durant's (PHX) path and initiates body contact that affects Durant's SQBR during the drive.
Adebayo (MIA) briefly has an arm positioned across O'Neale's (PHX) arm, which he moves through in order to close out toward Highsmith (MIA).
Nurkic (PHX) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Nurkic (PHX) jumps into Highsmith's (MIA) left leg, initiating contact that affects Highsmith's ability to elevate for the shot attempt.
Rozier (MIA) releases the throw-in within five seconds.
Butler (MIA) commits a take foul on Booker (PHX).
Butler (MIA) releases the throw-in within five seconds.
Booker (PHX) places a hand on Rozier's (MIA) body after he releases the pass, but the contact is marginal.
The game clock expires before Herro (MIA) receives the pass and attempts a shot.
